title: Cast Record
description: A locked character identity - the verdict of the casting stage. Casting is not choosing a model, it is fixing an identity; this is what every later shot is generated against and what the continuity check measures drift from. The export reads it to write per-scene model settings, a fixed seed and reference images into a VRGDG timeline (DECISIONS #32).

character.description: The character's name. Also how a song line names its singer.

brief.description: The description the identity was cast against. Every scene must re-state the character rather than referring back to one (DECISIONS #29, #33) - this is the text to re-state.

candidate.description: The winning stack. Produced by screen_test's Candidate.as_dict().

model.description: Model filename as ComfyUI lists it. The engine is resolved from the model registry by header, never guessed from this name (DECISIONS #18).

settings.description: Sampler settings the candidate ran with. Transplants only into a graph of the same shape (DECISIONS #25).

engine.description: Graph source that can drive this model, e.g. zimage, flux_klein. Normally resolved from the model registry rather than stated here; an explicit value overrides that.

seed.description: Fixed so a render reproduces byte-identically. It is reproducibility, not identity - holding the seed and changing the prompt drifts the face MORE than holding the prompt and changing the seed (DECISIONS #29).

references.description: One approved reference image per shot family. A reference is worth about 4x a description on a matched shot, but collapses when the framing changes - which is why these are per family and not one image (DECISIONS #30).

reference.description: LEGACY - a single reference image, no shot family. Written by screen_test.cast_record() and still accepted by the export. Prefer `references`, which DECISIONS #30 showed is what actually holds identity across framings.

measured.description: The axes that were actually computed for the winner. Absent keys mean not measured, never zero - the ranking reweights around what it could not compute rather than assuming it.

chosen_by.description: The machine narrows, the human casts (DECISIONS #15). An agent-chosen record is a draft, not a cast.
